_comment: Fill in your ACTUAL plan's $/1M-token rates below — none are pre-filled, since guessing at pricing would silently misinform cost decisions. Get these from: Groq console billing page, your Ollama Cloud plan, and your Azure OpenAI resource's pricing tier (Azure plans/regions vary). scripts/benchmark_models.py reports 'no rate configured' and skips cost math for any model left null here — it never fabricates a number.

llama-3.3-70b-versatile.used_for: live interview conversation, question selection, guardrail checks (services/llm.py, question_generator.py)

llama3.3:70b.used_for: fallback when Groq returns 429/5xx (code default — check your actual FALLBACK_MODEL env var, it may differ)

gpt-oss:20b.used_for: fallback when Groq returns 429/5xx — a reasoning model; noticeably slower than the two above per services/test_runner.py's own comments on it burning tokens on hidden reasoning
